selection: First8 distinct17-28-atom TRAIN compositions by fixed metadata hash; generator teacher samples are FIT only and disjoint from every evaluated composition. Generated graph-invalid starts are recorded and excluded identically from replay and physics pools; no replenishment. Anchors with no supported escorted particle are recorded and removed identically from all student pools; their zero normalizer estimates are not hidden.
objective: Alternate original-reference FM and FIT teacher-endpoint FM. Replay uses original retained anchors. Escort uses uniform valid force-escorted particles. Work uses the SAME particles with full local Jarzynski work weights. Identical model initialization, anchor choices, RNG draws, optimizer and inference budgets. No Gaussian FM score proxy or bond loss.
physical_target: Conditional on anchor A, q0=N_H(A,sigma_A^2 I) with sigma chosen from its force norm before source draws. The escort translates by delta=sigma_A^2 F_plus(A)/kT and has intrinsic Jacobian1. Target rho_A(Y)=q0(Y|A)*exp[-(E_plus(Y)-E_plus(A))/kT]*same_graph(Y,A). Work includes energy change and both Gaussian reference log densities. This is an anchored restrained local ensemble, not a global Boltzmann generator.
primary: Work versus unweighted escort common-graph-supported E_plus per atom; escort/work versus replay and frozen also reported. All-output energy, force, validity, diversity and local particle ESS retained.
pilot_gate: Work has lower paired common-graph energy than unweighted escort in each model seed, pooled conditional paired95 upper bound below zero, and no more than2pp pooled graph-validity or distinct-connectivity loss versus escort, replay or frozen. A pass supports utility of complete work weighting in this local teacher, not global Boltzmann calibration.
claim_boundary: Escorted Jarzynski identities and endpoint distillation are prior art. Finite-particle self-normalized work weights approximate a LOCAL Gaussian-restrained energy tilt; local ESS is not generator-output ESS. Chemical-isomer mixture weights and global thermal sampling remain unqualified. Legacy model temperature input stays1 and is not trained across temperatures. The10-condition evaluation is a reused development panel.
implementation_change: Before any teacher generation or student fitting, user requested Jarzynski inclusion. Replaced the unrun MALA draft with a force-escorted instantaneous-quench teacher and added its unweighted-particle control.
